name: Consent Management
one_liner: Consent capture, versioning, withdrawal and proof across channels and countries.
fits_when: patients give consent for several purposes (programme, marketing, sharing with their doctor, research) and each must be recorded separately
consent texts change over time and every consent must show which version the patient agreed to
consent is captured on a portal, by phone, on paper or by field staff and needs evidence such as an OTP log or a recording
patients withdraw consent or ask for a copy, correction or erasure of their data and must get an answer within a legal deadline
the programme runs in several countries under DPDP, GDPR or similar laws
gives_you: Consent policies per purpose and country, with versioned texts approved by the Privacy Officer
Consent capture on any channel with OTP confirmation and evidence (logs, recordings, signed forms) fingerprinted with SHA-256
Re-consent flagged automatically when a new version needs it
Withdrawal, access, correction and erasure requests with a 30-day clock and overdue flags
A patient 360 page with every consent and request, and a policy 360 with versions and consents

welcome.message: This is the Consent Management template, running on demo data. Switch roles with View as. Tell me what to change: flows, fields, screens, roles or the look. You can also build it as it is.
suggestions: Add a guardian who consents for minors
Make marketing consent expire after 12 months
Patients withdraw by replying STOP on WhatsApp

catalogue.description: One record of every consent a patient gives. Program Managers set up consent policies per purpose and country; the Privacy Officer approves each version of the text; Support Agents and patients capture consent on any channel with evidence; withdrawals and data requests are closed within the legal deadline, and a new version can ask patients to consent again.

packages.name: workflow
packages.description: State machines, approvals and SLA timers

roles.name: Program Manager
roles.description: Owns consent policies and texts and watches consent coverage

roles.name: Privacy Officer
roles.description: Approves policy versions, verifies evidence and closes data requests

roles.name: Support Agent
roles.description: Enrols patients and captures consent on their behalf with evidence

roles.name: Patient
roles.description: Sees and withdraws their consents and raises data requests

workflows.name: Consent capture
workflows.description: Any channel, confirmed by a one-time code, with evidence attached

workflows.name: Version control
workflows.description: Maker-checker approval of each policy text; re-consent when it changes

workflows.name: Withdrawal handling
workflows.description: Withdraw in one click; processing for that purpose stops at once

workflows.name: Consent evidence
workflows.description: OTP logs, recordings and signed forms, fingerprinted and verified
